description: Search CVEs by the words their description uses, ignoring case. By default it lists every CVE whose description uses any of the words, best match first; put a phrase in quotes to require it. With sort newest, the words must appear side by side and the newest CVEs come first. Words under three letters and common ones such as "the" don't count.

page.description: the page to return, starting at 1

query.description: the words to look for, such as ocsp or request smuggling, up to 500 characters

name: search_cves
title: Search CVEs
